reason: Reproduced with installed uv 0.12.13 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu), Ubuntu 24.04.5, and Python 3.12.3. Installed a local single-module wheel using `uv --no-config --offline pip install --python /usr/bin/python3 --cache-dir CACHE --target TARGET --link-mode hardlink --no-deps WHEEL`, with the destination module precreated. An LD_PRELOAD shim injected EXDEV during atomic hardlink replacement and EDQUOT only when writing the fallback warning to stderr. uv panicked at crates/uv-fs/src/link.rs:812:9 with 'failed printing to stderr: Disk quota exceeded (os error 122)' and exited with SIGABRT (-6). Allowing the warning write or selecting copy mode produced exit 0. This confirms the synthetic crash mechanism; actual quota exhaustion and the reported newer versions were not tested. Preferred error-handling policy remains a maintainer decision. The requested README update failed because its filesystem is read-only. The completed handoff, reproduction scripts, and results are saved under /tmp/uv-22278-5kaa99w7/, including README.md.
